$comment: THE CROSS-REPO DELIVERY CONTRACT — brick://53437107, DESIGN KD-3 + KD-4, TESTER-PLAN L3.1. Single source of truth for the strings and semantics that acpx EMITS and acpx-ui CLASSIFIES. acpx-ui vendors a BYTE-IDENTICAL copy; both repos' tests assert the same sha256 over these bytes, so a one-sided edit reds one of the two suites instead of passing silently for six weeks — which is exactly how the class-C contract mismatch survived. DO NOT REFORMAT: the sha is over the file bytes, not the parsed value.

quiesceRejection.$comment: What a submit_prompt gets at a draining owner. acpx asserts it emits exactly `message` with exactly `detailCode`/`retryable`. acpx-ui asserts isTerminalEnqueueFailure(message) === true. `requiredSubstringLowercased` is the rule both sides check the literal text against — assert the CLASSIFICATION, never a hand-copied string (TESTER-PLAN trap 4). Already-deployed acpx-ui satisfies this with no change, which is what lets acpx ship the barrier first.
quiesceRejection.message: Session is closed — the queue owner is draining for close and is not accepting new messages.

ownerExitTerminals.$comment: Owner exiting while the session is still OPEN — idle-memory release, TTL, deploy-staleness, crash, external kill. Never reached the model, so a resend is safe and acpx-ui re-drives it (D3/B5). `acpxUiDefinitiveGiveUp:false` is the POST-D3 target: today acpx-ui still buries this as definitive, which is the 48/48 defect B6 removes.
ownerExitTerminals.message: Queue owner shut down before the message was accepted

ownerExitTerminals.$comment: Owner draining because the session is CLOSING. Definitive on purpose: a close-caused loss must never be auto-retried into a session that has to stay shut (brick://8f3aaa73). The substring is what acpx-ui's isDefinitiveGiveUp matches on the lower-cased reason.
ownerExitTerminals.message: session closed before the message reached the agent — it was never delivered

ownerExitTerminals.$comment: Injected mid-turn, containing turn never settled (F3). The content MAY have reached the model, so this is outcome-unknown: never auto-resend, manual decision only.
ownerExitTerminals.message: delivery outcome unknown — the message may have been processed
